title: main/nftables: harden IPv6 MLD filtering and improve firewall ruleset
message:
main/nftables: harden IPv6 MLD filtering and improve firewall ruleset

* Require IPv6 hop limit 1 for MLD messages, as mandated by the
  protocol, to reject packets that should not be forwarded across
  routers.
* Reject IDENT (TCP/113) connections with TCP RST instead of ICMP Port
  Unreachable, using TCP's native connection-refusal mechanism for more
  predictable client behavior.
* Clarify that flush ruleset removes all nftables rules, including those
  managed by other software such as Docker, and should be disabled when
  the firewall is not managed exclusively by this configuration.
